$description: Lease Buddy Design Tokens V3 -- 'The Printed Brief'. Extends V2 shape language with grayscale-first color discipline, serif authority typography, single-page document layout, and confidence-stamp annotation components. W3C DTCG format. Author: Jo -- UI/UX Design Agent. Date: 2026-10-04.

color.$description: Primitives unchanged from V1/V2. V3 adds no new hues -- the differentiation is a usage-discipline rule (see $extensions.usageRationing below), not a new palette.

jo.usageRationing.$description: V3's core color rule. Sage appears AT MOST ONCE per screen as a non-interactive fill/stroke (the hero number, a confidence-stamp circle/bracket), PLUS the primary CTA button. Everything else renders in ink/graphite/slate/fog grayscale. This is a design-review rule, not a token -- flag any screen using sage twice outside the CTA.

ink.$description: Confidence-stamp stroke color -- the ONE earned sage use per screen, drawn like a pen mark.

typography.$description: V3 introduces a second typeface family. Inter remains all interface text. Source Serif 4 is reserved EXCLUSIVELY for hero numbers and dossier section headers -- never on interactive elements.

serif.$description: Reserved for hero numbers + dossier section headers ONLY. See brand-direction.md section 3.4.

heroSerif.$description: The single biggest number on any V3 screen -- e.g. calculated savings or fair-market price.

dossierHeader.$description: Serif, uppercase, tracking-widest. Section titles styled as a printed document header.

spacing.$description: 4px base grid, unchanged from V1/V2. V3 widens default page margins -- see $extensions.pageMargins.

jo.pageMargins.$description: V3 page padding: minimum 24px (space.6), preferred 32px (space.8). Wider than V2's 16px default -- whitespace signals composed authority, not crowding.

borderRadius.$description: V3: absolute zero. Even V2's pill-badge exception is removed -- badges use bracket annotations instead of radius. The only non-zero value is the page-turn control's drag affordance, which is purely functional, not decorative.

pill.$description: V2 used 9999px for pill badges. V3 removes pills entirely -- use bracket annotations (see components: confidenceStamp.bracket) instead.

layout.$description: V3-specific layout model: single-page document, not scrollable card dashboard.

maxContentWidth.$description: Caps line length for readability, mirrors a printed page's column width even on large screens.

confidenceStamp.$description: V3's signature annotation component family. Precise, ruler-straight -- never hand-drawn/sketchy. At most one per screen, applied to the single most important data point.

circle.$description: Drawn around the single number the user should lead with in negotiation.

bracket.$description: Spans two numbers being compared (e.g. dealer price vs. fair price), making the delta visible.

underscoreTick.$description: Short double-tick under a term with a tap-to-define glossary entry.

texture.$description: E-ink surface simulation, more pronounced than V2's flat paper grain -- includes a soft diffusion layer to avoid any screen-glow quality.

diffusionBlur.$description: Extremely subtle blur on large text fills, mimicking e-ink's soft pixel diffusion rather than crisp LCD anti-aliasing.

riskLevel.$description: V3's low/med/high signifier. Replaces the red/yellow/green traffic-light convention, which fails for red-green colorblindness and reads as 'good/bad' rather than 'more/less of the same thing' -- inaccurate for lease data (a high payment isn't evil, it's just high). Uses sage/slate/amber -- hues already in or near the V3 palette -- each paired with a distinct stroke weight so the hierarchy survives grayscale printing with zero color at all.

strokeWidth.$description: Hairline -- low risk/value gets the lightest visual weight.

bg.$description: Neutral slate-tinted background, distinct from both sage-50 and amber washes.
Pale amber wash -- 'pay attention,' not an alarm-bell red.

strokeWidth.$description: Boldest stroke -- high risk/value is unmissable even with color stripped out.

$extensions.jo.usageNote: This is the ONLY place amber is used as a semantic signal in V3. It does not count against the 'one sage use per screen' rationing rule in color.$extensions.jo.usageRationing -- risk-level indicators are a distinct, bounded component family, not general-purpose accent color.

shadow.$description: V3 uses shadow even more sparingly than V2 -- the document metaphor implies a flat sheet, not floating layers. Reserved for the overlay/modal scrim only.

motion.$description: V3 adds e-ink-style page transitions and a single 'drawn' animation reserved for confidence stamps.

pageTurn.$description: Cross-fade + 4px vertical settle, mimicking e-ink refresh. Replaces slide/push transitions from V1/V2.

iconography.$description: Lucide Icons, outline, 1.5px stroke -- unchanged from V1/V2. V3 uses icons more sparingly: prefer text labels over icon+label pairs.
